status: Fixed before downloading or inspecting any 2025-11-19..21 data. Rules and pass criteria below were written before any result of this follow-up was computed.
diagnosis: The inherited alarm level is chosen at 5% FPR on all purged validation rows (prevalence about 20%, mostly repeat signers) but applied to first-appearance test rows (prevalence about 5.5%). The population mismatch makes test FPR erratic (28.7% on Dec 1, 0.6% on Dec 5).

rules.inherited: threshold_at_fpr on all purged validation rows, budget 0.05 (current method).
rules.matched (primary): threshold_at_fpr on purged validation rows that are first appearances of their primary signer in the sampled window, budget 0.05.
rules.f1_matched (secondary): Threshold maximising F1 on the same validation first-appearance rows; ties resolved to the higher threshold.

models: Identity-controlled boosting models (readonly_identity_hgb baseline, context_identity_hgb HOMIE), settings unchanged; scores reproduced deterministically and checked against saved test predictions where they exist.
primary_endpoints: E1 (stability): under the matched rule, |test FPR - 5%| is smaller than under the inherited rule, for both models.

E2 (benefit): at each model's matched threshold, HOMIE recall minus baseline recall on test first appearances is positive with a 95% paired one-hour block bootstrap interval (500 draws, seed 42) entirely above zero.

fresh_window.selection: Latest three consecutive dates never used in the project before 2025-11-22. Shard index = int(sha256(f'{date}|homie-threshold-fresh'),16) mod the date's file count; row group 0.

retrospective: The rule is also applied to the Dec 1, Dec 5 and Nov 28 windows. Those test days were already inspected, so those results are secondary and descriptive; the primary confirmation is the fresh Nov 21 test.
reporting: All results retained and reported regardless of direction. Fresh evaluation runs once.
